STAGE 01 • REPOSITORY & VERIFICATION

Submit Claim Details & Documentation

A rigorous dispute analysis requires complete evidentiary foundation. Rather than generic summaries, our intake requires the exact administrative paper trail issued by the insurer and treating institutions.

lock ISO 27001 Data Confidentiality

Your medical history and financial records are encrypted at rest using AES-256 standards with zero non-advisory data sharing.

STAGE 02 • NOMINAL ₹500 AUDIT FEE

Initial Forensic Scrutiny

We test the insurer’s repudiation grounds against contract law, IRDAI master directions, and binding appellate precedents. Our legal analysts determine if the rejection has legal standing or constitutes unfair claims practice.

Transparent Assessment Policy

If the insurer’s repudiation is legally watertight under legitimate exclusion clauses, we inform you immediately without encouraging futile expenses.

Target Forensic Evaluation Vectors

shield_lock Insurance Act Section 45 Analysis

Examines claims beyond the 3-year policy window. Insurers cannot question policies on misstatement or concealment grounds once the 3-year period expires without demonstrating fraudulent suppression.

heart_check Non-Disclosure of Pre-Existing Disease

Dissecting common arbitrary rejections where lifestyle conditions (e.g. hypertension, mild diabetes) are erroneously linked to unrelated acute medical events without clinical causality.

percent Room Rent Proportionate Deductions

Challenging unlawful cascade deductions applied across pharmacy, diagnostic, and doctor fees simply because an upgraded room was opted for, contradicting policy terms.

price_change Reasonable & Customary Arbitrary Cuts

Contesting undocumented haircuts where third-party administrators (TPAs) slash surgeon fees, implants, and consumable items without publishing standard tariff benchmarks.

Deliverable: Preliminary Scrutiny Brief Detailed written assessment showing statutory feasibility score and projected recovery probability.
Turnaround: 48 Hours
STAGE 03 • FORMAL DRAFTING & RETAINER

Case Advisory & Formal Strategy

When legal viability is established, our senior advisors draft a comprehensive Grievance Memorandum. At this point, a ₹4,500 advance is deposited, which is 100% adjustable against our final success fee upon recovery.

100% Adjustable Retainer

The ₹4,500 advance demonstrates mutual commitment to administrative follow-through and is credited in full against the recovery fee.

The Grievance Memorandum Blueprint

A
IRDAI Master Circular & Regulatory Citation

Embedding references to IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations, mandated timelines, and circulars preventing claim rejections on hyper-technical grounds.

B
Apex Court & High Court Jurisprudence

Integrating Supreme Court benchmarks (e.g., Manmohan Nanda vs United India, Gurmel Singh vs National Insurance) establishing that genuine indemnity cannot be denied for clerical or non-fundamental omissions.

C
Regional Insurance Ombudsman Precedent Compilation

Referencing earlier final awards handed down by the same territorial Ombudsman registry on identical repudiation clauses, presenting an incontrovertible case.

Full Client Approval Gate: No submission proceeds without your reviewed consent. assignment_turned_in
STAGE 04 • INTERNAL ESCALATION MATRIX

Insurer GRO Escalation

Before approaching statutory authorities, policyholders must exhaust insurer-level avenues. We bypass branch managers and present the Grievance Memo directly to the Insurer's appointed Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) and Principal Officer.

15-30 Day Clock Running

Under IRDAI mandate, the insurer is legally bound to resolve or respond within 15 to 30 days. We log time stamps across every communication channel.

The Multi-Tier Channel Activation

LEVEL 1 Designated GRO

Corporate Grievance Office submission with indexed evidence dossier.

LEVEL 2 Principal Officer Copy

Notice addressed to company executive leadership indicating Ombudsman escalation readiness.

LEVEL 3 Bima Bharosa Portal

IRDAI’s integrated grievance tracking system token registration for regulator visibility.

Statutory Resolution Response Monitor IRDAI Mandated Window
Day 0: Formal Intake Day 15: Regulatory Reminder Day 30: Statutory Breach / Final GRO Response

Over 40% of cases are resolved at this stage once insurers recognize that the claimant is backed by rigorous legal documentation rather than unrepresented informal requests.

STAGE 05 • STATUTORY ADJUDICATION

Regional Insurance Ombudsman Filing & Hearing

If the insurer refuses redress or allows the 30-day statutory window to elapse, we escalate to the quasi-judicial forum: The jurisdictional Insurance Ombudsman established under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.

Jurisdictional Reach

Active coverage across all 17 regional ombudsman centers: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Chandigarh, Hyderabad, Lucknow, Pune, and others.

Ombudsman Petition Compilation & Prep

folder_special Form VI / Annexure Drafting

Preparation of prescribed petition forms, calculation schedules, chronologies of events, and evidentiary exhibits aligned with Rule 14.

quickreply Rejoinder to SCRC

Detailed rebuttal against the insurer's Self-Contained Rejoinder Compliance (SCRC) when they attempt post-hoc justifications before the Ombudsman.

videocam Hearing Simulation & Briefing

Comprehensive policyholder coaching for virtual or in-person Ombudsman proceedings, focusing on concise factual testimony and evidence signposts.

balance Binding Insurer Award Enforcement

Ombudsman awards are legally binding upon insurance carriers. Insurers must comply within 30 days of receiving claimant acceptance or incur statutory penal interest.

verified

No Court Stigma: Ombudsman proceedings are informal, policyholder-friendly, court-fee exempt, and completed without lengthy procedural delays.

STAGE 06 • DIRECT RECOVERY & RECONCILIATION

Recovery, Award & Reconciliation

Transparency defines our financial model. When the Ombudsman issues an award or the insurer agrees to settle, all claim disbursements are wired directly from the insurer into your bank account. ClaimSathi never holds or intercepts your claim money.

100% Direct Payout

We never take power of attorney for bank accounts. You retain absolute control over recovered funds.

Strategic Comparison

Handling on Your Own vs. ClaimSathi Structured Representation

Insurance disputes involve specialized regulations, strict deadlines, and complex policy terms. See why institutional representation fundamentally changes the outcome.

Evaluation Vector Handling on Your Own ClaimSathi Structured Representation
Repudiation Analysis Emotional appeals citing fairness; unable to parse technical exclusion definitions and subtle policy wordings. Contractual & Forensic Review: Section 45 checks, precedent cross-referencing, and IRDAI unfair-practices dissection.
Escalation Authority Emails to customer care agents, call-center loops, or local branch visits with limited response. Senior Grievance Escalation: Direct formal submission to designated GRO, Principal Officer, and integrated Bima Bharosa token registry.
Legal & Judicial Grounding Zero citations of binding judicial case law, regulatory master circulars, or appellate benchmarks. Authority-Backed Dossier: Supreme Court precedents, High Court orders, and specific ombudsman award precedents embedded in the submission.
Ombudsman Petition Filing Risk of procedural rejection due to incomplete annexures, elapsed 1-year statutory limitation, or missed Form VI requirements. Compliant Drafting: End-to-end petition compilation, chronological exhibits, and counter-rejoinders to insurer defenses.
Hearing Readiness Intimidated by experienced insurance panel officers; high probability of agreeing to deeply discounted compromise offers. Hearing Coaching: Focused advisory on articulating core evidence, answering technical queries, and pursuing maximum entitlement.
Time & Administrative Strain 6 to 18 months of frustrating administrative burden, lost working days, and emotional exhaustion during medical recoveries. Streamlined Process: Dedicated case managers handle paperwork, tracking, follow-ups, and calendar compliance.
